dispositions.rationale: No exact occupational mapping exists, so the package makes the formalization-versus-domain-truth boundary explicit rather than letting reasoner consistency become semantic authority.
dispositions.residual_gap: Observed ontology practice, multi-domain validation and cross-intelligence evidence remain untested.

nonclaims: No TEST scope or domain-truth authority is created.
RDF 1.2 status is Candidate Recommendation Snapshot, while OWL 2 Second Edition is referenced as a W3C Recommendation; no W3C specification text is reproduced as AXM canon.
